name: Canada
source: Rare meets Canada for the first time when she enters the school grounds for the day. She sees a student who she believes to be America. Upon closer inspection, he's revealed to be Canada. Rare marvels over how similar he looks to America, only for it to be revealed that the two are identical twins.
